$comment: Spend caps are off by default (null = no limit), by the owner's choice. The owner can set one in Settings. Concurrency ceilings stay: they protect AgentCore quotas, not spend. max_workers_per_goal is a hard cap on the live workers one manager may have on one goal at a time (the owner's choice after a 50-sentence request hired 21 workers); hire_worker refuses above it. worker_idle_release_minutes: a worker with no turn for this long and nothing moving goes home (released by the sweep), paused city included. Hard ceilings that hold even if prompts fail (the live site reached 400 agents and 311 tickets in one evening): max_live_workers_city (hire_worker), max_open_jobs (delegate_to_orchestrator), max_departments (create_department); all owner-editable in Settings.
